renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Affliction's arrival is the occasion, not the obstacle: with it comes nondifference, and nectar arises. [1] Affliction's arrival dated as nondifference's occasion: with it, not after it, the nectar rains. [2] It inverts the expected: suffering is not the enemy of recognition but its trigger.

paragraphs.text: Suffering arriving is not the obstacle — it is the occasion. Right along with affliction comes non-difference from the Lord, and nectar starts to fall. Not after the pain is over, but with it, at the same time.
That flips the whole expectation upside down: suffering is not recognitions enemy. It is recognitions trigger.
